subject: Proposal: Temporary staging pin for NovaX family to stabilize integration
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: Temporary staging pin for NovaX family to stabilize integration

Hi team,

Quick summary: Neon Labs shipped a NovaX-13b variant (v1.2) that exhibits a tokenizer delta and an attention micro-behavior that increases tail latency for short requests in our staging workload. We need a short-lived operational control so the product surface and customers are not exposed while we finish compatibility and telemetry work.

Ask: I propose we apply a "staged pin" to NovaX-13b::v1.2 for the staging and pre-prod pools for two weeks (14 days) with the following properties:
- routing fallback to NovaX-13b::v1.1 (compatible shim) for any request that would exceed our 95th percentile latency SLO
- automatic rollback/unpin after 14 days unless an owner requests extension
- require telemetry hooks (token-level latency + kv-cache hit rates) before unpin

What I need from each of you:
- Priyom: quick compatibility checklist and target evals (tokenization diffs, perplexity/quality regression on our prompt set)
- Dev: an implementation plan for the pin semantics, capacity reservation for a canary fleet, and the fallback policy wiring
- Lauren: messaging to stakeholders/customers and product sign-off for a temporary pin
- Marissa: CS/AM awareness for any customers currently using NovaX variants (so we can pre-empt support tickets)

I've attached basic integration notes from Neon and a short snippet of the failing traces. This should be a short protective measure — goal is to keep staging stable while we validate.

Attachments: novax_integration_notes.pdf (summary + traces)

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Temporary staging pin for NovaX family to stabilize integration

+1 on a temporary pin. A few quick notes from the ML side:
- Tokenization: v1.2 introduces a different pre-token merging for multi-lingual prefixes — I can run a 2k-sample diff against our eval set and send results by EOD.
- Quality gating: propose we require no >2% regression on our standard conversation prompts and no more than 0.5% increase in hallucination rate on the supervised evals.
- Telemetry: we need token-level latency histograms (per model variant) and a new KV-cache-hit metric (per request) instrumented as soon as possible.

If we get those metrics, I can own the go/no-go sign-off after 48 hours of canary traffic.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Applied ML — Model Safety & Compatibility
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Temporary staging pin for NovaX family to stabilize integration

Thanks Rohan — infrastructure side notes:
- We can implement a staged pin as a config flag on the routing service. Suggested schema: pin{model: "NovaX-13b", variant: "v1.2", mode: "staged", duration_days: 14, fallback: "NovaX-13b::v1.1"}. We'll add a forced-unpin endpoint for ops.
- Capacity: need to reserve a small canary pool (approx 8-10 gpus) to run 48–72h of traffic. I've attached the latest pool snapshot for Q2 so we can estimate headroom.
- Telemetry hooks: we can emit latency percentiles and KV-cache-hit per request, but need Priyom's exact metric names/labels to keep dashboards consistent.

Open items: who is the owner for extension requests? Also: do we want the pin to apply to both hosted and dedicated routing or only staging/pre-prod? My preference is staging+pre-prod only.

Attachment: capacity_snapshot_q2.csv

— Dev
Dev Patel
Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Temporary staging pin for NovaX family to stabilize integration

Thanks all — I agree with the staged approach and the 14-day window, with two small clarifications:
1) Roadmap timing: the canary should start after the integration docs are updated (I can own a short README for customers and the notice we send to CS). Target start: next Tuesday (2027-04-20) so we have time to update public docs and prepare a short FAQ.
2) Scope: pin should be staging + pre-prod only, not hosted production. We will not expose the pin to customer routing.

Action items I will take:
- Draft the external-facing note and the CS FAQ by Friday (2027-04-16).
- Align with Marissa on customer outreach list — Marissa, please flag any high-usage accounts that should be proactively contacted.

If everyone is OK with timelines, confirm and Dev can schedule the config rollout + telemetry hook.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Product Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Carmen Ortiz <carmen@neonlabs.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Neon Labs Integrations <integrations@neonlabs.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Temporary staging pin for NovaX family to stabilize integration

Hi Rohan & team — thanks for the quick review and the proposed plan. We appreciate the staged pin approach and will: 
- Send a concise changelog that explains the tokenizer tweak and the recommended shim for compatibility.
- Provide an extra build (v1.2.1) with the tokenizer shim if you prefer us to push a patched variant; otherwise we'll support the fallback routing you propose.
- Share a short set of stress traces and a MapReduce-style tokenization diff by EOD tomorrow.

We're happy to coordinate on documentation and can join a quick sync Wed if helpful.

Best,
Carmen Ortiz
Integrations Lead
Neon Labs
